FAQ

Webflow + Shopify, answered.

Shoppers browse and add to cart on Webflow, then finish on Shopify’s secure checkout — fully branded, with Shop Pay, Apple Pay and every payment method Shopify supports.

Yes. Products, customers, orders and apps stay exactly where they are. We connect your existing Shopify store to the new Webflow storefront through the Storefront API.

They do. We support Recharge, Shopify Subscriptions and bundle apps, with custom Webflow UI for subscribe-and-save toggles and bundle builders.

For brands where storytelling matters, yes: Webflow gives you unlimited layouts, a marketing-friendly CMS and premium motion, while Shopify keeps doing what it does best — checkout and operations.

Launch packages ship in 4–6 weeks. Grow builds with subscriptions and upsells take 6–8 weeks. Scale projects are planned in phases.
